description: Confirm a previously-created payment intent with a payment method. For card intents this triggers authorization; for APM intents this returns a next_action (redirect, QR, etc).

payment_consent_reference.description: Optional consent reference for MIT/recurring flows

payment_method.description: Payment method object (type + per-type fields). See Airwallex API payment_method schema.

return_url.description: Browser return URL for 3DS / APM redirects

name: confirm_payment_intent
